remarks: They don't make homeownership like this anymore. For more than 60 years, the same owner has called 2637 Stranahan Drive home - loving it, caring for it, and creating a lifetime of memories along the way. That's not just a long time to own a home… that's a story. Now, this well-loved Alhambra home with a private pool, bonus room behind the garage and A/C is ready for a new owner. Whether you appreciate the character of an older home, want to bring it into the next generation, or see the opportunity to create something uniquely your own, 2637 Stranahan offers a wonderful canvas and a connection to the past that simply can't be replicated.
